html: ‡ † [דַּחֲוָה] n.f. dub.;—pl. abs. דַּחֲוָן Dn 6:19, Vrss conject.; AV RV instr. of music (so AE, assuming meaning strike [strings] for דְּחָא [BH דָּחָה] thrust; Saad RVm dancing-girls; Bertholdt al. concubines (from sens. obsc. of Arabic دَحَى), but then read prob. לְחֵנָן (5:2, 3, 23) Marti Prince Dr.
